newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile stocks seen pushing higher on ADR demand.
newsitem.headline: Chile stocks seen pushing higher on ADR demand.

text.p: Chilean stocks were seen powering higher Wednesday on U.S. demand for ADRs, traders said.
"They are still buying our ADRs in New York, especially Endesa," a trader told Reuters.

The IPSA index of the 40 most-traded shares ended at 126.26 points Tuesday, up 0.74 percent, and the general IGPA index ended at 5,521.0 points, up 0.48 percent. Market turnover was back to normal after Monday's lull, totaling 15.8 billion pesos.
